$comment: ADR-038: the ONE domain/URL table per environment (founder, 23 Nov 2026). Go-live is configuration only: every consumer (Kiorly Home, GET /api/workspaces, the Passport client registrations in idp.json, each product's CORS + OIDC redirect/post-logout allow-lists, cookie settings, app-link association files, OpenTofu tfvars) is DERIVED from this file or asserted against it by tests (apps/dev-idp/test/domains.test.ts). Products stay separate deployments and never import this file: they receive the same values through their own env (see Docs/DOMAINS.md). Staging hosts are placeholders until the founder confirms them; no host here is a deploy.
cookiePolicy: Session cookies are HOST-ONLY (cookieDomain null) so a product never shares a cookie with another product; Home and the products share nothing but the Passport SSO session on account.kiorex.com. Secure + HttpOnly + SameSite=Lax in staging/production (Lax is required so the top-level redirect back from Passport carries the session). Never set Domain=.kiorly.com.
hsts: Send Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains on every kiorly.com host at the CDN (add preload only after every subdomain is HTTPS). NEEDS_HUMAN to submit to the preload list.
frameAncestors: Every product keeps frame-ancestors 'none' (clickjacking). The Passport pages likewise. Nothing embeds another product.

patient.$comment: GRW-P1-H. The Kiorex patient app (com.kiorex.app). Only the patient host is associated; the app resolves a link by matching its path against a route table, so no URL-valued parameter is ever followed. The Apple Team ID and the Play signing SHA-256 are NEEDS_HUMAN (KX-19 section 04) and come from config at publish time (APPLE_TEAM_ID, ANDROID_SHA256_CERT_FINGERPRINTS), never from this file.
